'''Jude Mandarano''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2000 Clarks Summit tournament]] on 1 October 2000 with EBO X-Wing Swarm, according to Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1291">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-02-clarks-summit-pa-10-1-00-part-ii-of-iid1291/ clarks-summit-pa-10-1-00-part-ii-of-ii], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 2 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-02-clarks-summit-pa-10-1-00-part-ii-of-iid1291/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
